title: Forge: PHP 8.1 Release Candidate Is Now Supported
content: <html><head></head><body>Starting today, you may install PHP 8.1 Release Candidates by choosing "PHP 8.1 RC" while creating a new server. Or, you may install the release candidate on an existing server via the PHP tab on a server's management dashboard.</body></html>
author: Nuno Maduro
